summary: Willamette NF L-4 cabin near Oakridge, dated 1938 by the Forest Service and Sand Mountain Society; the Forest Service page shows the site closed under a fire order.

access.note: Forest Service page shows Site Closed under a Cedar Creek Fire closure order; page last updated March 26, 2026. Otherwise a staffed fire lookout with limited access during operational periods.

visit.trail_note: Forest Service: trail 1/2 mile, easy. Sand Mountain Society: good gravel road, then a moderate hike of about a third of a mile; season late June to late October.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Willamette National Forest (Middle Fork Ranger District)

events.note: A lookout tree was established on the peak. Earlier structure, not the present cabin.
A trail was being built to the top and a fire lookout station was being erected. Earlier structure, not the present cabin.
Mrs. Lewis Flock was forest fire lookout at the Huckleberry Mountain tower that summer, per a Morning Register item quoted on the Oregon Lookouts page.
Eugene Register-Guard, October 1938: new cabins replacing antiquated structures on the same sites; CCC men expected to finish the Huckleberry station within ten days.
Build year given by the Forest Service and Sand Mountain Society. The register gives 1934 and firelookout.com gives 1939.
Oregon Lookouts timeline: L-4 model 1936 cabin erected by the CCC, first staffed in 1939.
Volunteers and the U.S. Forest Service restored the original structure, 1990 to 1991, per the register.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, September 3, 1991.
Sand Mountain Society: original restoration, including structural repairs, led by Roxie Metzler and the Friends of Huckleberry group. Oregon Lookouts also lists a 1992 roof restoration by volunteers.
Replaced rotted outrigger framing and original shutters.

corrections.why: The doubled nhlr.org path returned HTTP 404 on a live fetch. The register entry is at the single-host path, which is the one cited in this story.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 1934; firelookout.com gives 1939 and Oregon Lookouts says the CCC cabin was first staffed in 1939; Forest Service and Sand Mountain Society give 1938; the October 1938 newspaper describes the station being finished that year. The story uses 1938 for construction and 1939 for first staffing.

Register says 1990-1991; Sand Mountain Society says 1992 for the original restoration; firelookout.com says 1994; Oregon Lookouts lists a 1992 roof restoration. Each is kept as its own event with its source.
Forest Service gives a half-mile easy trail; Sand Mountain Society gives a good gravel road and a moderate hike of about a third of a mile. Both are shown.

notes_for_editor: Story is 452 words. Access rests on a Forest Service page marked last updated March 26, 2026 that shows the site closed under a Cedar Creek Fire closure order; re-check before publishing the access line. Build year is set to 1938 by the newspaper, Forest Service and Sand Mountain Society; the register (1934) and firelookout.com (1939) are noted in the story. The brief's height_m of 3.0 is supported only by a 1953 Coast and Geodetic Survey description of the house (about 10 feet), not by a tower height; the brief's source west_us_lookouts was not read. Published elevations disagree (register 5,451 ft, Sand Mountain Society 5,545 ft, firelookout.com 5549 ft) and are left out of facts. Photo credit noted on the register (2007 photo courtesy of Ron Kemnow) has no image URL, so no photo entry.
